# Python Tutor

> An interactive code visualizer and AI-powered tutoring platform for learning programming across Python, JavaScript, Java, C, and C++.

Python Tutor helps students and instructors visualize code execution in real-time, showing stack and heap memory layouts, variable states, and program flow. The platform combines interactive debugging with AI tutoring to make programming concepts more accessible and easier to understand.

## Key Topics

- Code Visualization
- Interactive Debugger
- Step-through Execution
- Stack and Heap Visualization
- Multi-language Support
- AI Tutor
- Python Programming
- Java Programming
- C/C++ Programming
- JavaScript Programming
- Programming Education
- Teaching Tool
- Online Compiler
- Memory Visualization
- CS Learning

## Core Platform

- [Python Tutor - Python Online Compiler with Visual AI Help](https://pythontutor.com/index.html): Homepage introducing Python Tutor's code visualization and AI tutoring across multiple languages.
- [Python Tutor Code Visualizer](https://pythontutor.com/visualize.html): Main interactive code visualizer and debugger supporting Python, JavaScript, C, C++, and Java with real-time execution visualization.

## Instructor Guides

- [Using Python Tutor for Java Programming Courses](https://pythontutor.com/articles/java-visualizer.html): Guide for instructors on using Python Tutor to teach Java programming concepts and help students understand object-oriented programming.
- [Using Python Tutor for C and C++ Courses](https://pythontutor.com/articles/c-cpp-visualizer.html): Instructor guide for using Python Tutor to visualize C/C++ memory management, pointers, and low-level programming concepts.
